page: Amazon Web Services g7.24xlarge is an accelerated computing instance built on the AWS Nitro System. It is powered by an Intel x86_64 processor providing 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs running at 3.9 GHz, utilizing single-threaded core execution without simultaneous multithreading. System memory totals 384.0 GB, delivering a 4.0 GB memory-to-core ratio.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by 4 NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 GPUs based on the Blackwell architecture, providing 128 GB of combined GPU VRAM. The instance includes 3800 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage and connects with a 350 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating large data ingestion and rapid data exchange between nodes.

The deployment of dedicated physical cores eliminates hyperthreading resource contention, ensuring predictable single-thread CPU performance across all 96 cores. Combining four workstation-class GPUs with 3800 GB of high-speed local NVMe storage provides strong resource density for disk-heavy graphics and computational pipelines, though architectures requiring higher host RAM per GPU may need careful memory management.

The g7.24xlarge server is suited for graphics-intensive applications, distributed rendering pipelines, workstation virtualization, video processing, and GPU-accelerated computing workloads requiring dense parallel compute alongside multi-hundred gigabit network performance.
